mission_goal: Frank v0.1 voll lauffähig auf Andreas Ubuntu developer system

zero_cost_evidence.claim: NVIDIA Developer Program members have free access to hosted NIM API endpoints for prototyping; individual endpoints may be rate limited.
zero_cost_evidence.counterhypothesis: A configured credential can belong to a different billing or production context; request execution must still stay on the documented integrate.api.nvidia.com developer endpoint and emit a receipt.

invariants: Never serialize, log, commit, echo or display API secret values.
Never access Together, including discovery, probes, routing and fallback.
Never make a paid request unless the project owner separately authorizes a nonzero budget.
A configured key is capability evidence, not proof of quota or health.
Except for an officially documented free developer endpoint, a configured key requires explicit host-side zero-cost attestation before routing.
A provider credential may only be sent to that provider's canonical host; a global multi-provider host allowlist is forbidden.
Authenticated provider requests must not follow HTTP redirects; redirects fail closed before credentials can cross an origin boundary.
Execution receipt request IDs bind provider, endpoint host and serialized request digest and remain stable across retries; attempt IDs are unique per execution attempt.
A response reaches VERIFIED only when choices is a non-empty list whose first message is an object with string content; malformed JSON shapes fail closed with a receipt.
An HTTP status response, including 429 and 5xx, proves EXECUTED transport but never VERIFIED or DONE; connection and timeout failures without an HTTP response remain unexecuted.
Every real provider request must emit a redacted execution receipt.
Rate limits and provider faults trigger bounded cooldown and rerouting, never retry storms.
